children.game_version: A follow-the-leader game moving in four directions.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm gestures and torso sway while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Hold a chair for balance while performing side-steps.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and limited range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Characteristic arm gestures accompanying the sway
movement_profile.footwork: Two steps right, two steps left, back, forward, turn
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Lines and columns, moving toward four cardinal directions
movement_profile.partnering: None; individual in a group formation

signature_moves.description: Rotating the formation to face each of the four cardinal directions.
signature_moves.name: Four-direction turn

music_profile.sound_description: Malay-influenced popular music characterized by the use of percussion and electric organs or accordions.

teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly, focus on synchronized movement in four directions.
